Phase membership uses native monotonic submission times and graph-call identifiers, not callback order or batch size. Shape counts describe original graph-node appearances before fusion. Helper wall time includes CPU work, GPU work and synchronization; it overlaps GPU intervals and must not be added to them. No CPU-only or SSD-wait duration is inferred from the gaps.
